open_points.subject: M18 FlowActivation identity referenced by M26 EffectAttempt.authority
open_points.text: M18 candidate fields: "flow_version_id", "highest_effect_class", "activated_by", "activated_at" ... M26: "a flow activation by its position in the store's order (M18)"
open_points.question: What exact stable reference to one FlowActivation is stored and exposed when EffectAttempt.authority points to a flow activation?
options: Add an explicit flow_activation_id field on M18 and reference that
Reference by a composite (for example flow_version_id + activated_at)
Reference by an internal store sequence/position that is not otherwise a model field
open_points.default_guess: Add an explicit flow_activation_id and use it in EffectAttempt.authority.

open_points.subject: FlowActivation.activated_by across activation paths
open_points.text: State 0: "the kernel activates a proven read-only version at once; any other version only when the owner asks"; K-15: "records name it as the actor" for automatic steps; M18 source: "The kernel, after proof and, for effectful versions, the owner."
open_points.question: Who is recorded in FlowActivation.activated_by for (a) read-only activation requested by agent/owner and (b) effectful activation requested by owner?
options: Record kernel for read-only automatic activations, owner for effectful activations
Record kernel for all activations because kernel writes the record
Record requester (owner/agent) for read-only and owner for effectful
open_points.default_guess: Kernel for read-only automatic activation; owner for effectful activation.

open_points.subject: M06 TrialCase.captured_from -> M23 NodeExecution reference
open_points.text: M06: "captured_from: the NodeExecution (M23) it was captured from"; M23 has no "node_execution_id" candidate field.
open_points.question: How is a specific NodeExecution referenced from TrialCase.captured_from?
options: Use a composite key (run_id, node_id, map_index, attempt_number)
Store a full embedded copy of the NodeExecution facts
open_points.default_guess: Use the composite (run_id, node_id, map_index, attempt_number) unless a dedicated id is added.

open_points.subject: StandingGrant applicability to read/draft-write nodes
open_points.text: State 0 action output: "the node of that flow version stops asking, or asks again"; M25 lifecycle: "A grant for a `read` or `draft-write` node is given like any other and is never used: those classes ask no approval."
open_points.question: Should granting a read/draft-write node be accepted as an inert record or refused because it cannot change asking behavior?
options: Accept and store the grant even though it has no runtime effect
Refuse grants for read/draft-write nodes as nonsensical
Accept for draft-write only, refuse for read
open_points.default_guess: Accept inert grants (as M25 states) and keep refusal only for destructive/inactive-version cases.

open_points.subject: M21 disclosure class rule for trial expected outputs when there are zero inputs
open_points.text: M21: "a trial case's expected output [takes] the highest class among that case's inputs"
open_points.question: If a contract version has no inputs, what disclosure_class is assigned to authored expected output values in trial cases?
options: Use each output port's declared class (if any)
Require explicit class from the author when adding the case
